jobs.title: The Founders
jobs.description: About us ABOUT TECHNOLOGY Anthropic partner MYTHOS CAREERS BOOK A DEMO Engineering got AI years ago. Engineering got AI years ago. Cloud security deserves its own. Cloud security deserves its own. While software engineers use AI to write code and ship faster, cloud security teams are still stuck sifting through millions of raw alerts manually. We believe cloud defense shouldn't be a manual workflow - it requires an autonomous agent that doesn't just point out problems, but actually fixes them. Copperhelm is the industry's first agentic cloud security platform. Founded by cloud and security veterans from Unity, McAfee, and RSA, Copperhelm acts as a dedicated, autonomous teammate for your security operations. Powered by our proprietary Context Lake, our purpose-built AI agents do the heavy lifting: continuously investigating active workloads, validating real risks, and executing real-time remediation. We eliminate the noise and the manual handoffs - instantly adding the capacity of twenty senior engineers to your team so you can focus on what matters.
